verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the agent can open and review pull requests with `gh`, which implies some pre-merge diff review done by the agent. Nothing documents a diff viewer for the developer, or running tests, linters or CI checks before merging. Missing for 10: a user-facing diff inspection UI, the ability to run tests/lint/CI checks pre-merge, detailed docs on the PR review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
